text.arabic_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

words.gloss_range: conjunction that opens a boundary between continuation and renewed warning
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not let the ayah begin as an isolated history notice. It both links back and restarts the warning, so the move from promised surplus to ruined peoples is heard as one boundary argument. Because the connector is fused to the following quantity word, the first shock of many destroyed generations arrives already attached to that transition.

topics.headline: opening connector links and restarts the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destruction report is joined to the prior discourse while also opening a fresh historical-warning unit.
topics.reason: The conjunction can coordinate with the prior discourse or resume a new unit; both values are locally coherent at the ayah boundary.

topics.headline: proclitic form makes the boundary shock immediate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the shift from reward-space to ruin-time as a connected contrast, not a topic break.
topics.reason: The written proclitic and boundary rows support a contrastive continuation from 50:35 into 50:36.

words.gloss_range: exclamatory-reportive quantity word functioning as the fronted object of the destruction verb
words.prose: {{ar:كَمْ}} ({{tr:kam}}) puts overwhelming quantity before the reader before the verb appears. Locally it functions as reportive-exclamatory rather than a request for a count, yet its question-shape still challenges the audience to reckon with the number. Its class is specified only afterward, so the ayah first creates the pressure of abundance and then reveals that the abundance is destroyed generations.

topics.headline: question-shaped quantity becomes emphatic report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening is not asking for arithmetic; it asserts a multitude while preserving interrogative challenge.
topics.reason: The min-governed specification supports reportive force while the surface interrogative form still contributes challenge.

topics.headline: fronted object makes number the first shock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels mass recurrence before agency, time, or the counted class are named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the quantity word as object of the destruction verb and the later genitive as its specification.

topics.headline: open abundance turns from gift to warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees open-ended abundance reversed from extra gift in 50:35 into destroyed multitude in 50:36.
topics.reason: The boundary row coherently links the unspecified surplus of 50:35 with the unspecified multitude in the warning.

words.gloss_range: completed causative destruction by the divine speaker; not neutral disappearance or self-perishing
words.root_gloss_range: ruin, perishing, loss, and destruction; the local causative force is constrained to a completed divine act of causing prior peoples to perish
words.prose: {{ar:أَهْلَكْنَا}} ({{tr:ahlaknā}}) compresses the destructive event, completed aspect, and divine first-person agency into one word. The root field makes the act ruin and perdition rather than mere disappearance, while the causative force keeps the prior generations as the affected object of a completed divine act. The word also belongs to a recurring destroyed-generation formula, so the history functions as evidence inside the warning, with the same speaker who grants surplus in 50:35 now named as the one who causes ruin. The recurring formula is concrete, with parallels at 6:6, 19:74, 19:98, 36:31, and 46:27.

topics.headline: perfect verb fuses completed destruction with divine agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning rests on completed divine acts, not hypothetical threat or anonymous collapse.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person plural surface and implicit-subject evidence confirm completed divine agency in the verb.

topics.headline: causative ruin replaces neutral disappearance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prior peoples as caused to perish in ruin, not simply gone from the scene.
topics.reason: The lexical and form evidence support ruin/perdition with causative agency while keeping the local object as the counted generation.

topics.headline: destroyed-generation formula makes history evidentiary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the clause as part of a recurring Quranic warning pattern, not an isolated historical aside.
topics.reason: The rows cite a stable h-l-k plus q-r-n pairing and parallels at 6:6, 19:74, 19:98, 36:31, and 46:27.

topics.headline: surah warning turns into historical proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 50:36 answer the earlier warning of 50:14 with historical proof and reverse the surplus of 50:35 into ruin.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows explicitly connect 50:36 with 50:14 and the boundary contrast with 50:35.

words.gloss_range: temporal precedence is selected locally while the wider root field of facing and relation colors the warning
words.root_gloss_range: temporal before-ness bound to a plural suffix; broader facing, direction, and reception senses remain background pressure
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلَهُمْ}} ({{tr:qablahum}}) makes the destroyed peoples prior to the warned audience, not merely distant. The attached suffix binds the past to the audience being addressed, while the wider root field of facing and relation keeps the past positioned before them as something they must confront. Its placement before the counted generation means the addressees are implicated before the old cohort is fully named. Same-surah recurrence also links this prior-destruction timing frame with 50:12 and 50:39.

topics.headline: temporal adverb binds the past to the addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the history is measured as before them, making the warning audience-specific.
topics.reason: Attachment and pronoun evidence make the word an accusative temporal adverb with suffix reference to the current warned group.

topics.headline: before-ness carries facing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses that the past is not flat chronology only; it stands before the audience as a pattern to face.
topics.reason: The local sense is temporal before-ness, while the broader q-b-l field of facing and reception can color without replacing that grammar.

topics.headline: prior destruction frame recurs inside the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the timing word help turn history into a repeated warning frame, including links with 50:12 and 50:39.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and same-surah rows support q-b-l as part of the prior-destruction warning frame.

words.gloss_range: explicative and partitive preposition specifying the class counted by the preceding quantifier
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the opening quantity legible by explaining what is being counted. It is not a simple source marker here: it specifies the class as generations while retaining a partitive pressure, as though the named destroyed cohorts are part of a wider historical field. The small preposition also slows the syntax, forcing the count to pass through grammatical specification rather than attaching bare and directly. Its nasal sound helps bind the specifying particle to the counted unit as one compact phrase.

topics.headline: explicative min gives the counted class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the many are not undefined victims; the preposition turns them into counted generations.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the preposition governs the counted noun as the explicative complement of the opening quantity.

topics.headline: preposition mediates and sounds the count phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and parses the count as a compact mediated unit rather than a bare direct attachment.
topics.reason: The syntax and sound rows both support the preposition as a small but visible bridge into the counted class.

words.gloss_range: linked cohort, generation, coupling, and horn/projection imagery; local sense is a human cohort destroyed as one historical unit
words.root_gloss_range: a generation or age-cohort as the counted class; not merely a chronological century or isolated individuals
words.prose: {{ar:قَرْنٍ}} ({{tr:qarnin}}) names the counted unit as a generation or age-cohort. The word is singular and indefinite, so each destroyed cohort is packaged as one unit while the opening quantity multiplies those units across history. Its root field of linking makes the cohort feel yoked by a shared time and fate, while the same root also echoes the companion motif inside Surah 50 at 50:23 and 50:27. Its compact closing sound reinforces that the counted unit closes before the comparison resumes.

topics.headline: generation specifies the opening count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader learns what the opening many consists of: historical cohorts, not an abstract number.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition while functioning as the specification of the quantity.

topics.headline: generation is a linked human cohort, not a bare century
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the destroyed unit as a people bound together by shared time, not merely a span on a calendar.
topics.reason: The local object of destruction selects human cohort; coupling and horn/projection imagery can color but not displace that sense.

topics.headline: singular indefinite packages repeated collective units
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one grammatical unit can stand for each repeated collective case in the warning.
topics.reason: The form evidence supports a singular collective noun multiplied by the opening quantity.

topics.headline: qarn belongs to destroyed-generation and Surah 50 echo fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the cohort word with recurring destruction formulas and with the qarīn companion motif at 50:23 and 50:27.
topics.reason: The rows support h-l-k plus q-r-n formulas, cross-surah examples such as 6:6, 10:13, and 36:31, and same-surah links with 50:12, 50:23, and 50:27.

topics.headline: closed sound finishes the counted unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the counted generation close compactly before the pronoun clause opens.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local and supports the structural close of the counted noun.

words.gloss_range: detached plural pronoun resuming the destroyed cohort as subject of a nominal comparison
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) reopens the singular cohort as a living plural subject. The destroyed generation has just been counted as one unit, but this detached pronoun lets it stand as people who can be compared and described. Because the next clause has no finite verb, the pronoun also supplies the subject hinge for the comparison before the ayah moves to their action. The repeated plural shape across the boundary also forces referent tracking; morphology alone does not identify the group.

topics.headline: detached plural resumes the cohort as sentient people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from a singular cohort noun to a plural subject of real people.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence confirms that the independent pronoun resumes the destroyed generation as subject.

topics.headline: pronoun opens a verbless comparative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the narrative pause to measure the destroyed peoples before reporting their movement.
topics.reason: The nominal clause requires a subject slot, and the following comparative is its predicate.

topics.headline: same pronoun shape demands referent tracking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader must track referents across the boundary because the same plural shape can point to different groups.
topics.reason: The pronoun rows support referential contrast and a small sound buffer before the comparative predicate.

words.gloss_range: tightening, firmness, severity, and attack-force; local grammar selects measured superiority, not generic greatness
words.root_gloss_range: comparative/superlative intensity narrowed by the following domain of violent seizure
words.prose: {{ar:أَشَدُّ}} ({{tr:ashaddu}}) makes the old peoples stronger only in a measured comparison, not simply impressive in every respect. As a predicate in a verbless clause, it states their comparative status before action resumes; the following specification narrows that superiority to violent grip. The root tightening and attack field gives the comparison compressed force, and the same sh-d-d field is already present in the severe punishment of 50:26, so human intensity is placed under divine warning. The same comparative formula recurs in destroyed-civilization warnings at 40:21 and 43:8.

topics.headline: verbless predicate measures superiority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees their strength as a measured status asserted before the narrative action continues.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the word as predicate of the pronoun in a compressed comparison.

topics.headline: superiority is narrowed to violent grip
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids hearing generic superiority; the comparison is specifically in the domain later named as coercive force.
topics.reason: The required accusative specification keeps the adjective from becoming unlimited praise.

topics.headline: tightening and attack imagery color the comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the comparative as compressed, force-applied intensity rather than loose capacity.
topics.reason: The wider root field can color the comparative, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as measured strength.

topics.headline: human intensity sits inside punishment and warning formulas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects stronger human grip with destroyed-civilization formulas at 40:21 and 43:8 and with severe punishment at 50:26.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah and cross-surah rows support the intensity-plus-seizure formula and same-surah punishment echo.

words.gloss_range: comparative min plus plural suffix setting the warned audience as the standard of comparison
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) supplies the standard for the comparison: the destroyed peoples were stronger than the warned group now being measured. The preposition is comparative here, so source-language pressure is narrowed into than-force, while the suffix keeps the audience inside the warning. Because the same plural suffix appears across the boundary with shifting referents, the word forces careful tracking of who is privileged, who is warned, and who has already been destroyed.

topics.headline: minhum makes the audience the measured standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the current audience is explicitly placed beneath destroyed peoples in the comparison.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the preposition-plus-suffix as the comparative complement after the adjective.

topics.headline: suffix referent shifts from destroyed people to warned audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks that identical plural morphology does not keep one referent; here it points to the warned group or broader audience.
topics.reason: The dominant local reading is current addressees, while the row noting broader audience possibilities prevents over-specific narrowing.

topics.headline: from-background survives inside comparative than-force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the audience exposed by comparison without turning the preposition into a source phrase.
topics.reason: The comparative function is local, while the general min range and boundary pronoun contrast can color the warning.

words.gloss_range: seizing and violent taking as a marked power-field; local use is a measurable domain, not one narrated seizure
words.root_gloss_range: violent grip, forceful seizure, coercive assault; locally the accusative verbal noun specifies the domain of comparison
words.prose: {{ar:بَطْشًۭا}} ({{tr:baṭshan}}) names the precise domain in which the former peoples were stronger: violent grip, seizure, and coercive force. As an indefinite verbal noun it turns an action-root into a measurable quality, not a single reported attack. That specificity matters for the warning, because the ayah does not say they were generally better; it says their capacity to seize and dominate was greater, yet it still could not produce escape. Its heavy consonant texture suits that coercive field, and it contrasts violent taking with the given surplus of 50:35.

topics.headline: accusative verbal noun specifies violent grip
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison is restricted to coercive grip, not all forms of power.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the word as accusative specification of the comparative adjective.

topics.headline: root means violent seizure, not generic strength
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines force as seizing and holding, which gives the power comparison moral and bodily texture.
topics.reason: Lexical evidence supports forceful taking and onslaught as the active branch, not neutral capacity.

topics.headline: indefinite verbal noun makes seizure a capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees violent seizure as a general capacity by which peoples are measured, not one incident.
topics.reason: The indefinite verbal noun abstracts the action into the comparison domain.

topics.headline: rare grip-root links intensity and destruction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this rare grip-word as the hinge between human intensity and divine destruction.
topics.reason: The distribution and co-occurrence rows connect b-t-sh with sh-d-d and h-l-k and with other seizure contexts.

topics.headline: abrasive sound and taking/gift contrast sharpen the word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a heavy coercive texture and sees violent taking contrasted with the given surplus of 50:35.
topics.reason: The phonetic row and boundary row add local payoff without changing the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: sequential or consequential connector that pivots from measured power to enacted movement
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from capacity to movement. It can mark sequence and consequence at once: their greater grip is followed by, and expressed in, their penetration through the lands. Because the connector is fused onto the exploration verb, the ayah moves from measured power to enacted roaming without explanatory delay.

topics.headline: fa holds sequence and consequence together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exploration is both the next beat after power and the action enabled by it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the sequenced clause, and the CRITICAL rows preserve the consequential nuance.

topics.headline: proclitic accelerates the move into action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels no gap between measured strength and land-penetrating activity.
topics.reason: The form and transition rows support an immediate pivot while preserving the comparative clause as a distinct beat.

words.gloss_range: boring through, piercing, searching, passage, and investigative penetration; local Form II makes the exploration intensive while variant readings narrow the contrast
words.root_gloss_range: Form II past plural action of penetrating, searching, or traversing through lands; local phrase selects thorough territorial exploration
words.prose: {{ar:نَقَّبُوا}} ({{tr:naqqabū}}) turns strength into intensive territorial penetration. The Form II surface makes the action repeated or thorough: not casual travel, but boring through, searching, and traversing the lands as an arena. At the same time, the verb has no overt direct object, so the following locative phrase defines range rather than a limited object. Variant readings reduce or redirect the force toward simpler Form I action or imperative challenge, but the standard local reading remains a past report of the destroyed peoples exhausting the lands without finding escape. The doubled sound at the root pressure point and the rare verbal root make comparison become audible movement.

topics.headline: exploration verb launches without a direct object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action feels expansive because no object limits it; the lands supply arena and scope.
topics.reason: Attachment and translation support confirm a prepositional complement rather than an overt direct object.

topics.headline: Form II intensifies boring-through exploration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees their movement as repeated territorial penetration, not ordinary travel.
topics.reason: The standard Form II and lexical branch support thorough exploration with the root image of piercing or boring through.

topics.headline: qiraat variants reveal what standard intensity preserves
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the standard report is stronger than variants that simplify the action or turn it into a command.
topics.reason: Variant evidence is useful as contrast, but it does not govern the canonical local parse.

topics.headline: rare root becomes the ayah movement beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a rare root supplies the only narrated action of exploration in the ayah.
topics.reason: The distribution rows mark n-q-b as rare and this surface as the lone conjugated verbal instance in the supplied field.

topics.headline: fa-bound verb opens the third beat with audible pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears comparison become movement as root image, doubled sound, and structural beat converge.
topics.reason: The structural and phonetic rows support the third-beat role and the auditory pressure of the intensive verb.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition that turns the lands into the arena and range of exploration
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the lands the field through which the action ranges. With an exploration verb, the preposition is more extensive than a static in: it spreads the action throughout the inhabited domain while keeping that domain as a locative arena, not a direct object. Its recitational joining to the next noun audibly binds the range-marker to the territory it governs.

topics.headline: locative preposition spreads exploration through the lands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action ranges throughout an arena, not into a single object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the preposition governs the land noun as the locative complement of the verb.

topics.headline: prepositional phrase scopes the exploration before no escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the explored domain become total enough to make the no-escape question sharper.
topics.reason: The phrase defines the arena after the exploration verb and prepares the final existential question.

topics.headline: liaison audibly binds preposition to governed noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition and land noun as one governed phrase in connected recitation.
topics.reason: The phonetic row supplies a local sound payoff for the grammatical bond.

words.gloss_range: bounded inhabited place, settlement, fixedness, and related dullness/inertness; local use selects settled territorial scope
words.root_gloss_range: definite plural lands, countries, or settled territories governed by the locative preposition
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبِلَٰدِ}} ({{tr:al-bilādi}}) is not just scenery. Its definite plural frames the explored world as a known total field of inhabited territories, many settled regions treated as one arena. The root field of bounded place, dwelling, and fixedness makes the contrast sharper: the powerful moved everywhere inside settled space, piercing and traversing it, but the fixed domain still yielded no escape. The same root also recalls 50:11, where land is tied to provision and revival, now reversed into territory crossed by doomed powers. The audible article boundary also suits the definite lands as a bounded domain.

topics.headline: definite plural universalizes inhabited territories
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the exploration range as the lands as a total civilizational field, not a few locations.
topics.reason: The definite plural and locative government support a broad territorial domain.

topics.headline: genitive case marks locative domain, not object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the lands as the governed arena of exploration rather than the actor, object, or source.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms genitive government by the locative preposition.

topics.headline: settled-place root contrasts with penetrating movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the paradox of restless movement across fixed inhabited space.
topics.reason: The local sense is lands or inhabited territories; fixedness and dullness/inertness remain coloring, not a replacement gloss.

topics.headline: land-scope is marked and reverses same-surah life imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the land word with death/departure associations and with 50:11, where land carried provision and revival before this reversal.
topics.reason: The occurrence and co-occurrence rows support marked land-scope, same-surah reversal at 50:11, and wider city/territory contexts.

topics.headline: moon-letter article keeps the territorial boundary audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the definite land noun as a bounded domain.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds local sound support for the definite territorial phrase.

words.gloss_range: polar interrogative particle used in the final no-escape question
words.prose: {{ar:هَلْ}} ({{tr:hal}}) opens the ayah final question as a real interrogative form carrying negative expectation. The denial is not merely stated; the listener must complete it internally. That makes the ending participatory: after destroyed peoples, greater grip, and land-penetration, the question remains formally unanswered because the expected answer is no escape.

topics.headline: polar question carries negative expectation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final question functions as denial without losing its interrogative form.
topics.reason: Attachment and translation support license a rhetorical question with no-escape force.

topics.headline: closing question makes the listener supply no
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the denial as an unanswered final pressure, not a flat assertion.
topics.reason: The existential question closes the ayah without an explicit answer, leaving the denial to be supplied.

topics.headline: surplus gives way to absence of escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boundary contrast between granted more in 50:35 and denied escape in 50:36.
topics.reason: The boundary row coherently connects the prior surplus scene with the final no-exit question.

words.gloss_range: pleonastic negative-polarity min after the interrogative, intensifying the search for any escape
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) intensifies the final question by asking whether there is any escape at all. Locally it is pleonastic in the negative-polarity interrogative frame, but its partitive background still presses the minimum: not even a portion, instance, or outlet survives. By standing between the question particle and the terminal noun, it delays the word escape and tightens the closure. As a recurring no-escape formula, the pattern also has parallels at 50:3 and 13:33.

topics.headline: extra min grammaticalizes total impossibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar denies even one possible escape, not merely a known escape.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify this as pleonastic min after the interrogative, governing the final noun.

topics.headline: partitive background denies even a portion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the no-escape claim descend to the smallest possible outlet.
topics.reason: The local grammar is pleonastic, while min partitive background can color the total denial.

topics.headline: min delays and fuses the terminal escape noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the no-escape formula tighten before the final noun, with parallels at 50:3 and 13:33.
topics.reason: The rows support the hal plus min plus indefinite formula, the delay of the terminal noun, and nasal binding in recitation.

words.gloss_range: swerving aside, evasion, falling back, and tight predicament; local mīm-form names the escape-route or means denied by the question
words.root_gloss_range: place, way, or act of escape by turning aside; locally indefinite under min so any possible side-exit is denied
words.prose: {{ar:مَّحِيصٍ}} ({{tr:maḥīṣin}}) is withheld until the final word, so escape itself becomes the last tested possibility. The mīm-form can name a place, means, or act of escape, and the question denies all of that: no route, no method, no side-exit. Its root image is swerving aside rather than simple forward flight, so the ayah closes by denying even lateral evasion from the path of destruction. The rare form, indefinite under the preceding preposition, and terminal position make the ayah arc collapse from many destroyed generations to not one escape. The closure also joins denied-escape formulas at 4:121, 14:21, 41:48, and 42:35, while the tanwin chain ties generation, grip, and escape into one cadence.

topics.headline: terminal noun supplies the withheld subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that escape is held back until the end and then tested as the subject of the question.
topics.reason: Attachment and ellipsis evidence support the noun as the existential subject despite genitive form after the preposition.

topics.headline: mīm-form denies both route and method
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the question denying not just refuge but any place or means of getting away.
topics.reason: The mīm-form evidence supports place/means/act range, and the hal-min frame denies the whole range locally.

topics.headline: root image denies lateral swerving escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines escape as turning aside from destruction, and sees that even that side-exit is closed.
topics.reason: The accepted root branch of swerving aside or evasion is locally active in the escape noun.

topics.headline: rare indefinite form searches for any instance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the question widen the search to any possible escape and then deny it through a marked rare root.
topics.reason: The low-occurrence and indefinite rows support rarity and any-instance force under the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: final position joins a Quranic no-escape formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final word as part of a recurring denied-escape closure, including 4:121, 14:21, 41:48, and 42:35.
topics.reason: The rows support terminal placement and cross-surah no-escape formulas with concrete parallels.

topics.headline: four-beat arc collapses many into no escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move from many destroyed generations through force and range into not even one exit.
topics.reason: The structural and phonetic rows support the destruction-to-no-escape arc, tanwīn chain, and constricted closing texture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَهْلَكْنَا / أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا / فَنَقَّبُوا فِى ٱلْبِلَادِ / هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: A stronger coercive capacity is converted into passage-making and countrywide search, but every route remains inside the field of destruction; force enlarges mobility without producing an exit.

activation_trace.role: Falling into ruin supplies the terminal condition that all movement fails to evade.
Strength and solidity establish unusually high capacity before its failure is tested.
Seizing with force makes that capacity coercive and materially effective.
A penetrating route through hard terrain turns power into passage-making.
Travel and searching across lands turns the passage into an attempted hunt for an outlet.
Bounded tracts of earth provide the many places traversed but never a beyond.
Deviation and flight name the absent lateral outlet that closes the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Many stronger predecessors were destroyed and found no refuge.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a failed escape experiment: superior force produces routes through whole lands, yet no lateral motion crosses beyond destruction.

baseline_models.mechanism: The destroyed unit is not merely a date but a cohort joined within one time and able to act as a collective rival; its earlier position makes it a tested precedent confronting the present audience.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence places the cohort ahead of the addressees as an already completed trial.
People conjoined in one time supplies the historical cohort rather than an isolated strongman.
Binding one thing to another gives the cohort functional cohesion.
Becoming capable of facing an opponent makes the joined cohort a power-bearing formation.

changed_reading.before: Qarn is only a past generation label.
changed_reading.after: Qarn is a bound, capable social formation whose completed history is placed before the audience as evidence that collective capacity gives no immunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context changes land from neutral escape-space into a medium that receives bodily loss without erasing it, is revived after death, and produces emergence. The traversed land therefore holds and releases people; it does not hide them.

activation_trace.role: Searching across countries treats terrain as a prospective escape medium.
The bounded earthly places are the material field whose function context revises.
The missing deviation marks the self-directed exit that terrain cannot supply.
The lower earth receives what is diminished from bodies, making disappearance spatially internal rather than beyond reach.
Guarding and preserving blocks earthly diminution from becoming erasure.
Rain-life revives earth and supplies the restorative operation.
The same bounded-land image becomes a dead and then reactivated substrate.
Loss of life marks the land-state that revival reverses.
Passage to the outside supplies a real emergence, but one generated from the land rather than found by fugitives.

structural_cues: 50:4 pairs what earth diminishes with preserved knowledge; 50:11 pairs a revived dead balda with the explicit analogy 'thus the emergence'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earthly diminution, preservation, revived land, and emergence; I infer that these functions govern the focus lands as custody and release. A live alternative is that 50:11 is only a resurrection analogy, without making the focus geography custodial.

changed_reading.before: The lands are merely the wide terrain across which fugitives fail to find refuge.
changed_reading.after: The lands are an inescapable medium: they receive without erasing and eventually release the dead, so their only effective exit is resurrection rather than flight.

context_deltas.mechanism: N-Q-B's branch of investigating interiors reverses direction. Those who search the external lands are themselves exhaustively penetrated: inner whisper is known, utterance is guarded, habitual deviation is named, and the cover is removed.

activation_trace.role: Searching hidden interiors and reports turns the travelers into investigators whose direction can be reversed.
Attempted deviation supplies what total knowledge and disclosure prevent.
Disclosure to the knower establishes access deeper than geographic reconnaissance.
Hidden self-talk supplies the innermost layer already reached.
Speech brought out by the tongue moves the trace from interior thought to exterior evidence.
Guarding and preservation prevent emitted speech from escaping the evidentiary field.
Turning aside from the path is the context's enacted near-image of the focus's absent maḥīṣ.
Removing a cover completes the reversal by exposing the formerly concealed subject.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from hidden whisper, to emitted and guarded speech, to attempted turning aside, to a removed covering and sharpened sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested concealment, surveillance, deviation, and disclosure; I apply N-Q-B's interior-search image reflexively to the searcher. The live alternative is the nearer branch B006, in which N-Q-B remains ordinary travel with no investigative reversal.

changed_reading.before: They conduct an outward search through lands for a route away.
changed_reading.after: Their outward reconnaissance is ironic: while they probe the landscape, their own interior, speech, evasions, and coverings are more completely probed and exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated SH-D-D image migrates from the predecessors' comparative strength to the severity of punishment. Their violent grasp is not met merely by a stronger rival agent; it is enclosed within a condition now bearing the strength predicate.

activation_trace.role: Strength and solidity first belong comparatively to the destroyed cohort.
Forceful seizure specifies how their strength operates.
Painful punishment supplies the encompassing condition into which the strength image moves.
The same force-and-severity branch now qualifies punishment rather than human capacity.

structural_cues: The exact SH-D-D root recurs in 50:26 as the adjective of punishment before it recurs in 50:36 as the comparative strength of destroyed peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root repetition and the two different hosts of the adjective; I infer a transfer of the strength frame from actors to consequence. A live alternative is ordinary descriptive repetition with no designed reassignment.

changed_reading.before: The comparison implies only that an even stronger destroyer overcame strong people.
changed_reading.after: Human strength is relativized by being shifted into severe punishment itself: their force becomes something enclosed, not the controlling measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humanly made penetration through lands yields no escape, but the later summons makes the earth itself split and rapidly release people into directed gathering. A breach and an exit do exist; they remove agency rather than restore it.

activation_trace.role: Piercing through to what lies beyond supplies the failed human attempt to manufacture an opening.
The absent escape distinguishes a self-chosen route from the later compelled opening.
The terrifying cry supplies the external summons that initiates emergence.
Movement to the outside supplies the exit that the focus question had denied as refuge.
The earth's splitting open creates the real breach that human tunneling could not turn into escape.
The lower earth itself becomes the opening medium rather than a terrain crossed at will.
Driving and collecting a group toward one destination fixes the direction of the exit.
Ease after difficulty makes this compelled opening effortless for its agent, unlike the failed human search.

structural_cues: 50:41-44 forms a causal sequence: nearby call, heard cry, emergence, splitting earth, and rapid gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the summons-to-splitting-to-gathering sequence; I contrast it with the focus's penetration and no-escape question. A live alternative is that the two openings are separate eschatological and historical images without a deliberate agency reversal.

changed_reading.before: No opening or exit can be found anywhere in the land.
changed_reading.after: An opening and exit are finally supplied, but as involuntary exposure and transport into gathering; the only successful breach is the opposite of escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's violent grasp diagnoses a failed power regime, while the closing instruction bars coercive control and assigns recitation and reminder to the hearer responsive to warning. The warning's content is force; its communicative method is not.

activation_trace.role: Seizure by force supplies the doomed mode of human power that must not govern the address.
Coercive compulsion names the role explicitly denied to the messenger.
A reminder that makes one remember replaces seizure as the operative intervention.
Recitation supplies the noncoercive medium of that reminder.
Anticipatory fear identifies the hearer's inward responsiveness rather than imposed compliance.
Threatening warning carries the consequence recalled by the focus destruction scene.

structural_cues: The final ayah joins 'not a compeller over them' directly to 'remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My warning'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forceful grasp, denied compulsion, and commanded reminder; I infer a contrast between the warning's violent history and its delivery. A live alternative is that jabbār means controller rather than coercive enforcer, weakening but not removing the contrast.

changed_reading.before: The destruction of stronger peoples can sound like a threat whose force is to be reproduced in proclamation.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes coercive grasp as doomed while the surah prescribes remembrance and recitation, not grasp, as the way its warning reaches a hearer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the singular companions in 50:23 and 50:27 are not the historical qarn's syntactic referent. It remains valid as an exact Q-R-N root resonance joining cohort, binding, and companion branches; render it only as a secondary social echo, not as a claim that qarn lexically means the judgment companion here.

activation_trace.role: A people conjoined in one time supplies the overt historical generation.
Binding one thing to another exposes attachment inside the generation image.
An attached companion makes the shared root relational and personally accountable.
The companion's disavowal turns attachment into contested responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The destroyed generation is an anonymous slice of historical time.
changed_reading.after: The generation can faintly register as a web of attachments whose companion-relations later reappear as testimony and disavowal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a syntax-level rather than root-level activation: the focus's 'hal min maḥīṣ' echoes 50:30's paired questions about fullness and 'hal min mazīd'. It stays anchored in the focus's no-outlet construction and branch-backed container images; render it as rhetorical topology, not as lexical derivation or a certain cross-reference.

activation_trace.role: Inextricable constriction supplies the closed human outlet in the repeated question form.
Filling to the measure of a container supplies the questioned capacity on the judgment side.
Increase and growth keep that intake rhetorically open when the human exit is closed.

changed_reading.before: The no-refuge question is an isolated closure of the historical example.
changed_reading.after: It can echo a larger asymmetry: no open outlet for the fleeing subject, while judgment's receiving capacity asks for increase.

strongest_changes: Land changes from escape terrain into a preserving, reviving, and finally opening medium whose exit leads to gathering.
N-Q-B's search image reverses onto the searcher as whisper, speech, evasion, and covering become known and exposed.
SH-D-D moves strength from violent cohorts into severe punishment, while the final instruction refuses coercive grasp as the warning's method.
summary.what_was_special: Exact B-L-D, Q-R-N, and SH-D-D recurrences, the near-image H-Y-S/H-Y-D, and the reversal from human tunneling to earth's compelled opening produced several distinct but coexisting mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: N-Q-B B008's interior investigation is branch-backed but more form-distant than the likely travel branch B006.
The Q-R-N companion resonance and repeated hal-min topology are secondary echoes, not syntactic disambiguations.
The B-T-SH/J-B-R contrast depends on reading the final denial of jabbār as a response to the focus's coercive power.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Superior force expands search but does not create escape.** `ه ل ك:B001` supplies ruin, `ق ر ن:B005` a generation, `ش د د:B002` intensity of strength, `ب ط ش:B001` forceful seizure, `ن ق ب:B006` traveling through and searching lands, and `ح ي ص:B001` turning aside. The sequence supplies strength → extensive penetration of lands → failed evasion. I infer that mobility and power enlarge the search space without changing the closed outcome. The ayah reads as a failed escape experiment.
2. **Their probing can be both geographic and investigative.** `ن ق ب:B005` supplies passes through rough ground and `ن ق ب:B008` investigation of hidden affairs. Because the question asks whether any escape exists, I preserve two searches: traversing territory and probing possibilities. Neither yields `مَحِيص`, making the closure cognitive as well as spatial.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 50:44 supplied the final reason no `مَحِيص` exists: rapid exits are immediately converted into gathering-and-driving. There is no unorganized interval in which geographic strength or investigative skill can create a side route.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Local perforation cannot make an ultimate exit.** `ن ق ب B005` supplies a pass through rough high ground and `ن ق ب B006` travel through lands in search of escape; `ب ل د B001` makes those lands bounded tracts. `ح ي ص B001–B002` then supplies attempted turning-away and a tight bind with no exit. The packet gives strong peoples opening and searching local routes, followed by the failed escape question; I infer a scale distinction between perforating bounded terrain and escaping the containing order. Their exploration reads as proof of spatial mastery’s limit, not lack of effort.

2. **The strongest grasp cannot loosen the larger fastening.** `ش د د B002` supplies intensity of strength, `ب ط ش B001` forceful seizure, and dormant `ش د د B001` fastening a bond. The generations can seize forcefully and bore through land, yet are gathered by the historical destruction formula and cannot find *maḥīṣ*. The packet supplies force and failure; I infer that their strength operates inside a firmer binding they cannot grasp or undo. “Stronger in assault” therefore reads as locally maximal force enclosed by a different order of constraint.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 50:41’s caller from a near place was the decisive later surprise. Generations had perforated and searched distant lands, but the summons is already near; their global movement cannot increase distance from it, whereas attentive hearing in 50:37 offers a non-evasive response.

baseline.text: Onlardan önce, onlardan daha güçlü nice nesli yok ettik. Ülkeleri baştan başa dolaştılar; kaçacak bir yer var mıydı?

findings.text: Güçlü kuşaklar sınırlı arazileri delip baştan başa dolaşabilir, fakat bu yerel hareketlilik onları kuşatan düzende bir yan çıkış açamaz.
Arayış hem coğrafi geçitleri dolaşma hem gizli imkânları soruşturma olarak işler; kaçışın bulunmaması kapanışı düşünsel olduğu kadar mekânsal yapar.
Onların en sert yakalama gücü, içinde hareket ettikleri daha sıkı bağı gevşetemez; yerel kuvvet daha büyük bir kısıt düzeni içinde kalır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3: Penetration, Resistance, and Effortless Assembly
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Passage through resistant space exposes the difference between limited human force and divine operations that incur no fatigue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human probing resembles exhausting movement through a wasteland, while the final opening of earth is itself a strenuous rupture yet produces light, compliant motion for those gathered.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Exhaustive Probing Without Escape
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Strong generations range through lands, pierce routes in search of an outlet, exhaust their effort, and find no escape.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin kaybolma, bozulma, ölme veya bütünüyle ortadan kalkma sonucuna varmasını ve geçişli kullanımda başkasının bu sonuca sürüklenmesini açıkça destekler. Korku, yoksulluk ve azap adlandırmaları ile yatağın üzerine düşme kullanımı çekirdek anlamdan ayrı, bağlama bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği gerçekleşmiş yok oluş veya işlev kaybıdır; tehlikeye atılma, yer adı, açgözlülük ve özel kalıplar bu çekirdeğe katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerdeki yok olma ve yok etme çekirdeği ile sahibinin elinden çıkma, yiyeceğin bozulması ve yatağa düşme gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kaybolarak, bozularak, ölerek veya bütünüyle ortadan kalkarak varlığını ya da işlevini yitirmesi; geçişli kullanımda bir başkasının bu sonuca sürüklenmesidir. Korku, yoksulluk ve ağır eziyet için söylenmesi ile yatağın üzerine düşme kullanımı bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey kaybolma, bozulma, ölüm veya ortadan kalkma sonucunda varlığını ya da işlevini yitirir.
Geçişli kullanımda bir kişi veya güç başka bir şeyi yok oluş ya da ağır bozulma sonucuna sürükler.
Korku, yoksulluk ve ağır eziyet de yol açtıkları yıkım bakımından bu adla anılabilir.
Belirli bir yatak ifadesinde anlam, kişinin yatağın üzerine düşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, varlığın veya işlevin kayıp, bozulma, ölüm ve yoklukla sona ermesidir. Geçişli kullanım bu sonucu başkasına yöneltir; ağır sıkıntı adlandırmaları ve yatağa düşme örneği ise çekirdeğin özel bağlamlardaki uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Varlığın ya da işlevin kayıp, bozulma, ölüm veya ortadan kalkmayla sona erdiği çekirdek durum ile bunun başkasına yaptırıldığı geçişli kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem yok oluş sonucunu hem de bir başkasını bu sonuca sürükleme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin, malın veya düzenin ağır bozulma ve yok oluşa uğradığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağır bozulma ve yok oluş sonucunu güçlü biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Sahibinin elinden çıkma gibi daha tarafsız kayıp kullanımlarını ve geçişli yönü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kişinin yatak veya döşek üzerine düştüğünü bildiren özel kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Özel kullanımın düşme hareketini ve hedef yüzeyi eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yok oluşa düşme ve düşürme ekseninde daha sıkıdır; odak dal ise kayıp, bozulma, ölüm ve bütünüyle ortadan kalkma türlerini daha geniş biçimde bir araya getirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sahibinin elinden çıkma ve yiyeceğin bozulması gibi özel gerçekleşmeleri de barındırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sapma, bela ve yıkım yeri gibi kendine özgü değerlendirme ve bağlamları da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da kişi veya şeyin bozulması, geçersizleşmesi ve yok olması ortak alandır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem kişinin kendisini sonu yok oluş olan tehlikeye atmasını hem de sonu böyle bir yok oluşa varan şeyi bildirir. Kuş örneği çekirdeği açıklayan özel bir olaydır; gerçekleşmiş ölüm veya uçurumun kendisi dalın tanımı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sınır, gerçekleşmiş yok oluşta değil, kişinin kendini ona götüren tehlikeye atmasında ve bu sonucu doğuracak tehlikede kurulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tehlikeli sonucu adlandıran biçimler ile korkan kuşun kendini tehlikeye atmasını bildiren özel ifade ayrılır; anlam yalın yok olma fiiline genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin kendisini ölüm veya ağır yok oluşla sonuçlanabilecek bir tehlikeye atması ve bu sonuca götüren tehlikenin kendisidir. Korkudan kendini tehlikeli bir yere atan kuş, eylemin özel örneğidir.

facets.statement: Kişi kendisini sonu ölüm veya ağır yok oluş olabilecek bir tehlikenin içine atar.
Sonunda yok oluş bulunan şey veya durum, bu sonucu doğuracak tehlike olarak adlandırılır.
Yırtıcıdan korkan bir kuşun kendisini tehlikeli yerlere atması bu eyleme örnek verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin kendisini yok oluş ihtimali taşıyan bir duruma atması ile sonu yok oluşa varacak tehlikeyi aynı anlam alanında birleştirir. Korkan kuş örneği, korunma çabasının bizzat başka bir tehlikeye girişe dönüşebildiğini gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: kendini ölümcül tehlikeye atma ve buna götüren tehlike
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem kişinin kendi eylemini hem de eylemin sonunda yok oluş doğurabilecek tehlikeli durum veya şeyi birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleyen kişinin kendini tehlikeye atmasını, tehlikenin ölümcül sonucunu ve sonuç doğuran şeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin ağır sonucu bile bile ya da korkuyla göze aldığı tehlikeli girişimler için doğal bir anlatımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin kendi eylemiyle ciddi tehlikeye girmesini güçlü biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Tehlikeli şeyin kendisini adlandıran sonuç odaklı yönü dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.collision: Gerçek ateş sanılmaması için bağlam gerektirebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, tehlikeden önceki girişe değil, kayıp, bozulma, ölüm veya yok oluş sonucunun gerçekleşmesine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da ölüm veya ağır yok oluş ihtimalinin bulunduğu aynı sonuç zincirinde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal riskli giriş ve ona yol açan tehlikedir; komşu dal ise bu zincirin gerçekleşmiş yok oluş sonucudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi salınarak ve kırıtılarak yürüme hareketini doğrular, fakat kadın için kullanılan ağır ahlaki niteleme bu hareketin zorunlu anlamı değil, eski ve küçültücü bir değerlendirme uzantısıdır. Tanım hareket çekirdeğini öncelemeli, değer yargısını ayrı bir kullanım olarak göstermelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kadın yürüyüşündeki salınma ve kırıtmayı temel alır; ahlaki yargı tarihsel bir niteleme olarak ayrılır ve genel yok oluş anlamı dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yürüyüşü bildiren ifade hareketi anlatır; kadın için kullanılan ad ise hareketle ilişkilendirilmiş eski bir küçültücü nitelemedir ve ikisi tek yargıda eritilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kadının yürürken veya cilveli davranırken bedenini salındırıp kırıtmasıdır. Bu harekete bağlanan kadın adı, bazı eski kullanımlarda ayrıca ağır ve küçültücü bir ahlak yargısı taşır.

facets.statement: Kadın yürürken veya cilveli davranırken bedenini salındırır ve kırıtılmış hareketler yapar.
Hareket biçiminden türeyen kadın nitelemesi eski kullanımda küçültücü bir ahlak yargısına dönüşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak hareket görüntüsü, yürürken salınan ve kırıtılan bedendir. Bazı açıklamalar bu görüntüyü doğrudan yürüyüş ve cilveyle verirken bazıları kadın için ağır bir ahlaki nitelemeye dönüştürür; ikinci yön çekirdeğin değerlendirme uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kadına bağlanan hareket çekirdeğini, yani yürüyüş veya cilve sırasında bedenin salınmasını ve kırıtılmasını doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hareketin salınma, kırıtma ve yürüyüş bağlamlarını birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız yoksulluğu değil, kötü durumdaki kişilerin geçim ve korunma için sürekli olarak kendilerine bakacak kişilere veya iyilik sahiplerine yönelmesini anlatır. Bu nedenle tanım, ekonomik durumu ve yinelenen yardım arayışını birlikte korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ölüm veya yok oluşu değil, yoksulluk yüzünden sürekli yardım ve koruyucu arayan kişi ya da topluluğu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal, kötü durumdaki yoksulların sürekli yardım veya bakım aramasını anlatır; özel bir söz öbeğinden genel yoksulluk anlamı türetilmez.

concept_map.definition: Kötü geçim koşulları yüzünden kendisine bakacak birini veya insanların yardımını sürekli arayan yoksul kişi ya da topluluktur.

facets.statement: Kişi veya topluluk kötü geçim koşulları ve yoksulluk içindedir.
Bu kişiler kendilerine bakacak birini veya başkalarının yardımını sürekli arar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kötü durumdaki yoksulları, yalnız maddi eksiklikleriyle değil, geçim ve bakım için insanların iyiliğine tekrar tekrar yönelmeleriyle tanımlar. Tekil kişi ile böyle kişilerden oluşan topluluk aynı çekirdekte birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: geçinmek için sürekli yardım arayan yoksullar

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluk, yardım arama ve sürekli yönelme bileşenlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir kişinin geçim veya korunma için sürekli bir destekçi aradığı anlatımlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tekil kişinin yoksulluğunu ve sürekli yardım aramasını birlikte korur.
